answer: Agents can earn access to high-value trades only by posting collateral that is slashed when an identity is caught double-spending or coordinating fraudulent claims. A meadow of independent auditors checks signed transaction histories, while a trellis of repeated interactions makes reputation costly to fake; quartz escrow locks funds long enough for disputes to surface. A Sybil attacker must fund every new identity separately, so multiplying accounts multiplies capital at risk rather than cheaply multiplying influence.
